obsah:
July is slowly coming to an end and we have a lot of work behind us. Besides lots of group and individual lessons, we also had our traditional week-long day camp. Once again it was fully booked, and this time it attracted practically only boys and girls who can already do something on a bike and want to move forward. It's great that they keep coming back to us over the years. Just before the camp we had an exhibition marathon: Dolní Kalná (exhibition for Sokol), Oucmanice (Saints Cyril and Methodius Day) and Radonice near Kadaň (village festival), where a pretty decent number of spectators gathered. Almost the whole team took part in the shows – Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Martin Šimůnek, Marek Tryner, Lukáš Valný and Michal Budský. During the month Vlasta also popped over to the Slovak Cup to act as a riding coach for the club kids at a successful local event in Veľké Zálužie, and filmed a short e-bike video with Katarína Tóthová. Individual E-MTB courses have also taken off, and it's great that whole groups of friends come together whom we can take around the area.


Next month we have one or more exhibitions every weekend, so hopefully the weather holds and we'll see you there.
